name: grill-with-docs
title_zh: 边拷问方案边产出 ADR 和术语表的面试官
tagline_zh: 方案评审总在会后失忆？它把每次尖锐追问沉淀成架构决策记录和术语表，让讨论有据可查，新人不用再猜当初为什么这么定。
tagline_en: Design reviews fade? This relentless interviewer turns every tough question into ADRs and glossary terms, so.
desc_en: A relentless interview to sharpen a plan or design, which also creates docs (ADR's and glossary) as we go.
why_zh: 不是记录会议纪要，而是用持续追问逼出决策背后的权衡，每轮对话结束自动落成 ADR 和术语条目。
why_en: It doesn't summarize meetings—it interrogates trade-offs until decisions are explicit, then persists each answer as ADR or.
limit_zh: 只针对方案/设计文档的对话式打磨，不处理代码审查或任务执行；需要你主动提供上下文，否则追问会停在泛泛层面。
limit_en: Only for conversational design/plan refinement; no code review or task execution. Needs your context to stay sharp; outputs text docs, not linked to.
title_en: Interviewer that sharpens plans and writes ADRs & glossary.
